knowledge:
- key_parameters: norm_method=Sample normalization applied before scaling ('NULL'=none, 'MedianNorm', 'SumNorm', 'CompNorm', 'SpecNorm') ;; transform=Data transformation ('LogNorm'=base-10 log, 'CrNorm'=cube-root; passed as the 3rd arg to Normalization) ;; scale=Feature scaling ('AutoNorm'=auto/unit-variance, 'ParetoNorm', 'RangeNorm', 'MeanCenter') ;; fc_threshold=Fold-change cutoff for FC.Anal (default 2.0) ;; p_threshold=FDR/raw p-value cutoff for Ttests.Anal (default 0.05) ;; mtc=Multiple-testing correction for the t-test ('fdr','bonferroni','holm','none') ;; vip_cutoff=Number of top VIP features to display in PLS-DA importance plot ;; mset_lib=Metabolite set library for enrichment ('smpdb_pathway','kegg_pathway','predicted') ;; anal_type=InitDataObjects analysis type ('stat' for the general statistical module, 'msetora' for over-representation enrichment)
- alternatives: ropls (OPLS/PLS-DA + VIP in Bioconductor) ;; structToolbox (structured STATO-compliant pipelines) ;; MetaboAnalyst web server (the GUI equivalent of this package) ;; MixOmics (sparse multivariate methods)
- when_to_use: Use for downstream statistical analysis of a processed LC-MS/GC-MS/NMR peak-intensity table with known sample class labels: normalization, univariate significance (fold-change, t-test, volcano), multivariate class discrimination (PLS-DA + VIP), and optional metabolite-set/pathway enrichment from a named compound list. It is the canonical R equivalent of the MetaboAnalyst 'Statistical Analysis [one factor]' and 'Enrichment Analysis' modules.
- pitfalls: input_orientation=Read.TextData with 'colu' expects samples in COLUMNS with a 'Label' row; this workflow auto-transposes a features x samples matrix into that format ;; two_group_only=Fold-change/volcano and 2-group VIP interpretation assume a binary class; multi-class PLS-DA VIP is per-component and less directly interpretable ;; overfitting_plsda=PLS-DA on p>>n data overfits; always check cross-validated Q2 (PLSDA.CV) not just the score plot separation ;; normalization_order=Sample normalization, then transformation, then scaling — reversing the order changes results ;; github_only=MetaboAnalystR is NOT on Bioconductor/CRAN; it and OptiLCMS install from GitHub (xia-lab), which is why they are baked into the domain image rather than resolved at runtime.

workflows.name: statistical_metabolomics_analysis
workflows.intent: Run the canonical MetaboAnalyst statistical pipeline over a processed peak-intensity table with two-group class labels: normalize (log + auto-scale), find significant features by fold-change and t-test (volcano), discriminate classes with PLS-DA and extract VIP scores, and optionally run metabolite-set/pathway enrichment on a supplied compound list.
input: peak_intensity_table.csv (numeric matrix: features as rows, samples as columns)
class_labels.csv (sample sheet: sample id -> group label, 2 groups)
compound_list.txt (optional: one compound name per line, triggers enrichment/pathway analysis)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialise mSet (InitDataObjects 'conc'/'stat') + read peak table and class labels ;; 2. SanityCheckData, ReplaceMin, FilterVariable, then Normalization (LogNorm + AutoNorm) ;; 3. Fold-change analysis + t-test + volcano plot ;; 4. PLS-DA: score plot, cross-validation, VIP scores ;; 5. Optional over-representation enrichment (msetora) from a compound list ;; 6. Save mSet RDS, significant-feature and VIP CSVs, PLS-DA and volcano plots
workflows.code:
mSet <- InitDataObjects("conc", "stat", FALSE)
mSet <- Read.TextData(mSet, "metaboanalyst_input.csv", "colu", "disc")
mSet <- SanityCheckData(mSet)
mSet <- ReplaceMin(mSet)
mSet <- FilterVariable(mSet, "F", 25, "none", -1, "mean", 0)
mSet <- PreparePrenormData(mSet)
mSet <- Normalization(mSet, "NULL", "LogNorm", "AutoNorm", ratio=FALSE, ratioNum=20)
mSet <- FC.Anal(mSet, 2.0, 0, FALSE)
mSet <- Ttests.Anal(mSet, FALSE, 0.05, FALSE, TRUE, "fdr", FALSE)
mSet <- Volcano.Anal(mSet, FALSE, 2.0, 0, 0.75, FALSE, 0.1, TRUE, "raw")
mSet <- PlotVolcano(mSet, "volcano_plot_", 1, 0, "pdf", 72, width=NA)
mSet <- PLSR.Anal(mSet, reg=TRUE)
mSet <- PlotPLS2DScore(mSet, "plsda_score_plot_", "pdf", 72, width=NA, 1, 2, 0.95, 1, 0)
mSet <- PLSDA.CV(mSet, "T", 5, "Q2")
mSet <- PlotPLS.Imp(mSet, "plsda_vip_", "pdf", 72, width=NA, "vip", "Comp. 1", 15, FALSE)
saveRDS(mSet, "metaboanalyst_mSet.rds")

outputs.objects: metaboanalyst_mSet.rds — the full MetaboAnalyst mSet object holding the normalized data matrix, all analysis results (fold-change, t-test, PLS-DA), and provenance; re-loadable for further MetaboAnalystR calls.
outputs.tables: significant_features_ttest.csv / significant_features_foldchange.csv — features passing the t-test FDR and fold-change cutoffs (with statistic, p/FDR, log2FC); plsda_vip_scores.csv — per-component VIP importance ranking each feature's contribution to class separation; enrichment_ora_results.csv (optional) — over-representation pathway hits with hit counts and p-values.
outputs.plots: plsda_score_plot_*.pdf — 2D PLS-DA scores showing class separation; volcano_plot_*.pdf — log2 fold-change vs -log10 p, highlighting significant up/down features; plsda_vip_*.pdf — top VIP features bar chart.
outputs.images: PNG renditions of the above plots when produced.
outputs.versions: versions.yml — pinned MetaboAnalystR package version for provenance.
